description: Fix the specified ball velocities. As a result, ball motion is constant in the specified directions (fixed velocities are not updated during cycling).

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: Ball.set_fix(component, True) where component (1-based): 3D 1=X, 2=Y, 3=Z, 4=RX, 5=RY, 6=RZ; 2D 1=X, 2=Y, 3=spin - requires iteration

description.6.0: Fix the x -component of the angular velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(x\) -component of the angular velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(x\) -component of the angular velocity.

description.6.0: Fix the y -component of the angular velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(y\) -component of the angular velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(y\) -component of the angular velocity.

description.6.0: Fix the z -component of the angular velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(z\) -component of the angular velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(z\) -component of the angular velocity.

description.6.0: Fix the x -component of the translational velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(x\) -component of the translational velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(x\) -component of the translational velocity.

description.6.0: Fix the y -component of the translational velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(y\) -component of the translational velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(y\) -component of the translational velocity.

description.6.0: Fix the z -component of the translational velocity.
description.7.0: Fix the \(z\) -component of the translational velocity.
description.9.0: Fix the \(z\) -component of the translational velocity.

examples.command: ball fix velocity-x velocity-y velocity-z spin-x spin-y spin-z range position-x -3 -1
examples.description: Fix all velocity and spin components for balls in x-position range
Fix z-velocity for balls in 'bottom_grip' group (common in compression tests)
Fix translational velocity (all components) for balls in y-position range

examples.command: ball fix velocity-x velocity-y range id 1 100
examples.description: Fix x and y velocities (allow z motion) for balls 1-100
